'''Zan Porpu''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He went missing during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] when his [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] disappeared in the [[Esstran Cordon]].
